prep.text: Coop delivery (Fri or Sat morning) has everything for this week. Freeze 1 pack of chicken (700 g, for Thu). ICA: just the prawns, any day before Fri.
Lunch: kofta makes 3, eat it all.
Dinner: tagine makes 7. Box 2.5 for Sun lunch and 1 for Mon lunch; freeze 1. Keep half the couscous for Sun lunch.
Dinner: goulash makes 6 (about 1 h 50 min, mostly simmering). Box 2.5 for Mon dinner and 1 for Tue lunch, with potatoes.
No cooking. Freezer buffer: 1 tagine — swap into any solo lunch.
Dinner: fishcakes make 4 (salmon goes straight from frozen into the air fryer). Box 1 for Wed lunch.
Dinner: quesadillas make 4. Box 1 with salsa kept separate for Thu lunch. Evening: move the chicken from freezer to fridge.
Dinner: noodles make 4. Box 1 for Fri lunch. Evening: move the prawns from freezer to fridge.
Assisted-quick dinner. Tomorrow is the week B ICA shop.

recipes.name: Lamb kofta pittas with mint yoghurt & tomato salad
ingredients: 400 g lamb mince (lammfärs)
50 g frozen chopped onion (thawed, squeezed); 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp cinnamon, black pepper; flat-leaf parsley
1 pack pitta bread
2 dl Turkish yoghurt; fresh mint; 1 lemon
1 cucumber, 3 tomatoes, 2 spring onions, 1 tbsp olive oil
steps: Mix mince with onion, spices, pepper and snipped parsley; shape 10 fingers.
Air fry at 200°C for 10–12 min, turning halfway, until well browned.
Mix yoghurt with snipped mint, lemon zest and half the juice.
Dice cucumber and tomato; snip spring onion; dress with olive oil and the rest of the lemon.
Warm pittas 2 min in the second air fryer; fill with kofta, salad and yoghurt.

recipes.name: Chicken, chickpea & apricot tagine with couscous
ingredients: 1.4 kg chicken thigh fillets (kycklinglårfilé, 2 × 700 g), in large chunks; 2 tbsp olive oil
200 g frozen chopped onion; 2 carrots, in coins; 4 cm ginger, grated
2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp turmeric, black pepper; 2 tbsp tomato purée
2 cans chickpeas, rinsed; 400 g crushed tomatoes; 4 dl water; 100 g dried apricots (no added sugar), halved
1 lemon; flat-leaf parsley and mint
5 dl couscous; 1 tbsp butter
steps: Brown chicken in oil in two batches until deep golden; set aside.
Cook onion and carrot in the same pan until the water is gone and it turns golden, 10 min. Add ginger, spices and purée; fry 2 min.
Return chicken; add chickpeas, tomatoes, water and apricots. Simmer, lid half on, 30 min until thick.
Pour boiling water over the couscous and butter, cover 5 min, fluff with a fork.
Finish the tagine with lemon zest and juice and plenty of parsley and mint.
recipes.note: Freezes well — freeze 1 portion as buffer.

recipes.name: Beef & paprika goulash with potatoes
ingredients: 1 kg beef chuck (högrev), in 4 cm chunks; 2 tbsp rapeseed oil
200 g frozen chopped onion; 2 tbsp tomato purée
2 tbsp paprika (1 sweet, 1 smoked), 1 tsp caraway seeds (kummin), crushed; 1 tsp dried thyme; 2 bay leaves; black pepper
2 red peppers, in strips; 2 carrots, in chunks; 400 g crushed tomatoes; 5 dl water
1.5 kg potatoes, scrubbed
2 dl crème fraîche; 1 tbsp red wine vinegar; flat-leaf parsley
steps: Brown beef in oil in 3 batches until deep brown, 4–5 min each; set aside.
Cook onion in the pan until the water is gone and it turns golden, 10 min. Add purée, paprika and caraway; fry 1 min without burning.
Return beef; add peppers, carrots, tomatoes, water, thyme and bay. Simmer, lid on, 1 h 15 min until the beef is tender.
Boil the potatoes in their skins for the last 20 min.
Stir the vinegar and plenty of pepper into the goulash. Serve with potatoes, a spoon of crème fraîche and parsley.

recipes.name: Salmon & dill fishcakes with crushed peas
ingredients: 4 frozen salmon fillets (laxfilé, 500 g)
700 g potatoes, scrubbed, in chunks
1 egg; 2 spring onions; fresh dill; 1 lemon; black pepper; 1 dl panko; 1 tbsp rapeseed oil
400 g frozen peas; 1 tbsp butter
2 dl Turkish yoghurt
steps: Boil potatoes 15 min, drain and mash roughly. Meanwhile air fry the salmon from frozen at 180°C for 14 min; flake.
Mix salmon, potato, egg, snipped spring onion, plenty of dill, lemon zest and pepper. Shape 12 cakes and coat in panko.
Brush with oil; air fry at 200°C for 12 min in both air fryers, turning halfway, until golden.
Cook peas 3 min; crush with butter and half the lemon juice.
Mix yoghurt with snipped dill and the rest of the lemon juice.

recipes.name: Sweet potato & black bean quesadillas with corn salsa
ingredients: 600 g sweet potato, in small cubes; 1 tbsp rapeseed oil; 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika
1 can black beans, rinsed; 150 g grated mozzarella
8 wholewheat tortillas
200 g frozen sweetcorn, thawed; 2 tomatoes; 2 spring onions; 1 lime
2 dl Turkish yoghurt; 1 avocado
steps: Toss sweet potato with oil and spices; air fry at 200°C for 15 min, shaking twice.
Mash roughly with the beans and the juice of ½ lime.
Spread over 4 tortillas, sprinkle with cheese and top with the rest. Air fry one at a time per air fryer at 190°C for 4–5 min, until crisp.
Salsa: corn, diced tomato, snipped spring onion and the rest of the lime.
Cut into wedges; serve with yoghurt, avocado and salsa.

recipes.name: Peanut-sesame chicken noodles with cucumber & edamame
ingredients: 700 g chicken thigh fillets, in strips; 1 tsp sesame oil; 8 cm ginger, grated; black pepper
250 g egg noodles; 200 g frozen edamame
2 carrots, in ribbons; 1 cucumber, in sticks; 2 spring onions
Sauce: 3 tbsp peanut butter (100% peanuts), 1 tbsp sesame oil, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 lime, 4–5 tbsp hot water
1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted; chilli flakes for adults
steps: Toss chicken with sesame oil, half the ginger and pepper. Air fry at 200°C for 12–14 min, shaking halfway, until golden.
Whisk peanut butter, sesame oil, vinegar, lime juice, the rest of the ginger and hot water until smooth.
Cook noodles, adding edamame for the last 3 min. Drain and rinse briefly.
Toss noodles with the sauce, carrot and cucumber; top with chicken, snipped spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Prawn, pea & lemon pasta
ingredients: 300 g wholewheat pasta (fullkornspasta)
400 g large frozen peeled prawns, thawed
200 g frozen peas; 1 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp olive oil; ½ tsp chilli flakes (adults: extra at the table)
1 dl crème fraîche; 1 lemon; 30 g parmesan, grated; flat-leaf parsley; black pepper
steps: Cook pasta, adding the peas for the last 2 min. Save 1 dl of the water, then drain.
Meanwhile fry prawns in butter and oil 2–3 min until pink; add chilli.
Toss pasta with prawns, crème fraîche, lemon zest and juice, parmesan and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with pepper and parsley.

items: Large peeled prawns 400 g — hand-pick (not small räkor), any day before Fri
